run_sentence_generator: run the HolisticBias sentence generator CLI to generate and save CSVs of noun phrases and base sentences
generate_sentences_with_small_set: run the sentence generator with --use-small-set to sample only 100 descriptors for faster generation
get_sentence_from_generator: get a randomly selected sentence with stylistic variations from the HolisticBiasSentenceGenerator using get_sentence
compile_noun_phrases: compile all noun phrases from descriptors and nouns into a DataFrame using get_compiled_noun_phrases
load_dataset_version: load a specific dataset version's descriptors, nouns, templates, and standalone noun phrases using class methods
